AI agents MUST NOT be listed as authors or co-authors of git commits.
Do NOT use `Co-authored-by:` trailers for AI agents
Do NOT add AI agents to commit author fields
The human developer who reviews and commits the code is the sole author
FINOS-wide: all umbrella projects require contributors’ signed CLA; AI agents cannot sign CLAs.

morphir-scala: Scala 3.7.4, Mill 1.1.x, ZIO, ScalaJS, experimental Scala Native. Layout: `build.mill`; `mill-build/src/` (`millbuild/`); `morphir/`: `src/`, `jvm/src/`, `js/src/`, `contrib/`, `interop/`, `runtime/`, `testing/`, `tools/`; `.config/mise/`; `project/`.

mise:
mise run setup
mise run lint
mise run fmt
mise run test:jvm
mise run test:js
mise run ci:local

Mill:
./mill morphir[3.7.4].jvm.compile
./mill morphir[3.7.4].jvm.test
./mill mill.scalalib.scalafmt.ScalafmtModule/reformatAll 'morphir.__.sources'

`morphir/foo/`: shared `src/`; JVM `jvm/src/`; JS `js/src/`; Scala 3.x `src-3/`; JVM + Scala 3.7.x `jvm/src-3.7/`. scalafmt 3.10.4; Scala 3 dialect; 120 columns. Run `mise run fmt` before committing. Prefer `given`/`using`, `enum`, `derives`, extensions, `*` imports, `mvn""` (not deprecated `ivy""`), ZIO li
